GREENFIELD COMMUNITY LIBRARY - MEMBERSHIP RULES (fictional)

1. ELIGIBILITY
Membership is free for residents of Greenfield district. Non-residents pay an annual fee of 300 rupees. Children under 12 need a parent or guardian to sign the application.

2. HOW TO JOIN
Bring one photo identity document and one proof of address to the front desk. The library card is issued the same day. A replacement card for a lost card costs 50 rupees.

3. MEMBERSHIP TYPES
Standard members may borrow up to 6 items at a time. Student members (with a valid student ID) may borrow up to 8 items at a time. Child members may borrow up to 4 items at a time.

4. RENEWAL
Membership must be renewed every 2 years at the front desk or online. An expired card cannot be used to borrow items.

5. CONDUCT
Mobile phones must be on silent in reading rooms. Food is not allowed in reading rooms; drinks in closed bottles are allowed. Members who damage library property must pay the replacement cost.
